title: Growing Up in the Spirit of Correction
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he tackles the challenging topic of spiritual maturity and the need for healthy correction in the church. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Zehner will help you understand why correction is essential for spiritual growth and how to receive it with humility and gratitude. Don't miss this insightful message that will challenge you to grow in your faith and deepen your relationship with God.
